facts.text: The hotel is in Budapest's historic city center, beside St. Stephen's Basilica.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Historic City Center beside the famous St. Stephen’s Basilica

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from Budapest's pedestrian shopping and dining streets.
facts.excerpt: next to St. Stephen's Basilica and just steps from pedestrian shopping and dining streets

facts.text: The hotel occupies a restored 19th-century former bank.
facts.excerpt: sits in a meticulously restored 19th-century former bank a short walk from the pedestrian shopping and dining streets

facts.text: The hotel's boutique design is inspired by music.
facts.excerpt: Beautiful Boutique Hotel Design Inspired by Music

facts.text: Rooms and suites are split into four musically themed towers, jazz, classical, opera and contemporary, and each is named for an artist or composer in that genre.
facts.excerpt: separated into four musically themed towers—jazz, classical, opera, and contemporary—with each accommodation named for an artist or composer in that genre

facts.text: Rooms in the Classical wing have Neo-Baroque furniture and Murano glass chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Neo-Baroque furniture and Murano glass chandeliers in the Classical wing

facts.text: Rooms in the Jazz tower have Art Nouveau flair and touches of Old Hollywood glamour.
facts.excerpt: Art Nouveau flair and dashes of Old Hollywood glamour in the Jazz tower

facts.text: Bathrooms are lined with onyx and have separate showers and tubs.
facts.excerpt: The onyx-lined bathrooms feature separate showers and tubs

facts.text: Accommodations include a Romeo & Juliet Balcony Suite.
facts.excerpt: Romeo & Juliet Balcony Suite

facts.text: The hotel has a year-round rooftop with 360-degree city views.
facts.excerpt: Stunning Year-Round Rooftop with 360˚ city views

facts.text: The High Note SkyBar is the hotel's rooftop bar, with a panorama of Budapest.
facts.excerpt: High Note SkyBar awaits locals, tourists and guests from all over the well with delicious summer cocktails, tasty barfood selection, laidback atmosphere, and a breathtaking panorama of Budapest!

facts.text: The lobby-level Music Garden courtyard, topped by a glass roof, is the hub of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Topped by a state-of-the-art glass roof, the lobby-level Music Garden courtyard now serves as the hub of the hotel

facts.text: Evenings in the Music Garden feature live music, with a different musical genre each evening.
facts.excerpt: accompanied by a different musical genre each evening — from swing and Latin rhythms to classical music, French chansons and pop favorites

facts.text: Breakfast is complimentary each morning.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Breakfast Each Morning

facts.text: There is a complimentary wine and cheese reception in the afternoon.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Wine & Cheese Reception in the Afternoon

facts.text: Wi-Fi is free.
facts.excerpt: Free High-Speed Wireless Internet

facts.text: The hotel has a pool, spa, fitness center, steam bath, sauna and whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Pool, Spa, Fitness Center, Steam Bath, Sauna & Whirlpool

facts.text: The Harmony Spa is underground and has a heated pool, a Jacuzzi, a steam room, and Finnish and infrared saunas.
facts.excerpt: The subterranean Harmony Spa’s got a heated pool with Aqua Bikes, Jacuzzi, small gym, steam room, Finnish and infrared saunas

facts.text: Guests can arrange a romantic balcony serenade played live by the hotel's musicians.
facts.excerpt: Surprise your beloved one with a romantic balcony serenadeEnjoy your favorite songs live as played by our pro musicians

facts.text: A small theater off the lobby hosts intimate performances and screenings.
facts.excerpt: A small theater off the lobby hosts intimate performances and screenings

facts.text: An in-house Musical Director helps guests plan musical itineraries in the city.
facts.excerpt: in-house Musical Director, who’s on hand to help craft musical itineraries in the city

facts.text: The hotel is a member of the Library Hotel Collection.
facts.excerpt: A member of the Library Hotel Collection

facts.text: Aria Hotel Budapest was ranked the number 6 hotel in Central and Southern Europe in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.
facts.excerpt: #6 Hotel in Central and Southern Europe according to Condé Nast Traveler's Reader's Choice Awards 2026
